pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown, irregularly polygonal contiguous regions with rounded vertices. Edge gradients are smooth. Patch area is significantly larger on the shoulder and lateral flank compared to the narrower, more elongated patches on the lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Cream-colored interstitial pathways forming a continuous topological lattice. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial. Pixel thickness of the pathways is relatively uniform throughout the visible shoulder and neck regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal ridge of the neck presents a continuous, low-amplitude serrated silhouette with a high-frequency textural frequency.
